trap.label: what × which
trap.wrong: The first stanza describes rain, what creates a calm tone.
trap.right: The first stanza describes rain, which creates a calm tone.
trap.why: Em português “o que” serve para os dois usos. Em inglês, para comentar uma oração inteira use which, não what.

fix.wrong: The poet compares the words like glass.
fix.right: The poet compares the words to glass.

rewrite.prompt: Una com which: “The poem ends softly. This creates calm.”
rewrite.answer: The poem ends softly, which creates calm.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com compare…to: “The poet says the words are like glass.” (compares)
rewrite.answer: The poet compares the words to glass.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com tone: “The poem is calm.” (The tone…)
rewrite.answer: The tone of the poem is calm.
